seoTitle: How to Add Zapier to Squarespace (2026 Guide)
metaDescription: Connect your Squarespace site to Zapier so form submissions, orders, and sign-ups flow into your CRM or spreadsheets automatically.
intro: Squarespace collects a lot of valuable data through forms and orders, but it doesn't do much on its own once submitted. This guide shows how to connect your Squarespace site to Zapier through the Extensions panel, authenticate the connection, and choose a trigger event so new submissions or orders flow into your other tools automatically.

steps.heading: Open Squarespace Extensions
steps.body: Access your Squarespace settings and navigate to the Extensions menu.

steps.heading: Find and connect Zapier
steps.body: Search for Zapier and initiate the account connection.

steps.heading: Authenticate your site permissions
steps.body: Approve site permissions and select your target website.

steps.heading: Build a new Zap
steps.body: Open Zapier, build a new workflow, and select Squarespace as your trigger.

steps.heading: Choose your trigger event
steps.body: Pick a specific event, like a form submission or an order placed.

steps.heading: Test the connection
steps.body: Fetch sample data fields to confirm the integration is working correctly before connecting your action app.

faq.question: Where in Squarespace do I find the Zapier connection?
faq.answer: It's located in the Extensions menu inside your Squarespace settings.

faq.question: What Squarespace events can trigger a Zap?
faq.answer: Trigger events include things like a new form submission, a product order, or a member sign-up.

faq.question: Do I need to authenticate separately in both Squarespace and Zapier?
faq.answer: Yes, you approve site permissions inside Squarespace and also authenticate the connection when building the Zap in Zapier.

faq.question: Can I send form submissions straight to my CRM?
faq.answer: Yes, once connected, you can map form submission data into an action step that sends it to a CRM, email tool, or spreadsheet.
